name: z1
style: Flat 2D side view illustration from a children's picture book about animals. {subject}, seen exactly from the side, the whole animal visible standing on all its legs, cute and friendly with a happy face but realistic proportions, isolated and centered on a solid uniform pure chroma-key green (#00FF00) background. No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only. Every colour has a second, slightly darker flat shade on its lower or shadow side, giving a simple two-tone shading. Bright warm colours, clean simple shapes. No green anywhere on the animal. No text, no ground, no grass, no shadow, no scenery.

items.giraffe: A single tall giraffe facing right with a very long neck held up high, orange brown patches on a cream body, small horns
items.zebra: A single zebra facing right with bold black and white stripes, a short black and white mane and a tail
items.hippo: A single round chubby purple grey hippopotamus facing right with its big mouth closed, small ears and short legs
items.rhino: A single grey rhinoceros facing right with two horns on its nose, thick skin folds and short legs
items.meerkat: A single small tan meerkat standing upright on its back legs facing right, with dark eye patches and a thin tail
